summary: TORONTO, Nov. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Barrick Mining Corporation (NYSE:B)(TSX:ABX) has received notice of an unsolicited mini-tender offer made by New York Stock and Bond LLC (“NYSB”) to purchase up to 50,000 of Barrick's common shares at a below-market price of US$26.40 per share. NYSB's below-market offer price of US$26.40 per share represents a discount of approximately 34.91% to the closing price of Barrick common shares on the New York Stock Exchange on November 6, 2026, the last trading day before the mini-tender offer was commenced.
